query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

User with 6GB 3050 wants to split i2v diffusion work onto CPU/RAM after OOM; asks how.

desired.outcome: anr2me (C0): CPU diffusion is impractically slow; ComfyUI already offloads weights to RAM by default. rattus128 (C3): CPU/GPU split tested and 'not really effective'; recommends KJNodes FFN-chunker nodes to cut inference VRAM for Wan/LTX on low VRAM.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: anr2me (C0): CPU diffusion is impractically slow; ComfyUI already offloads weights to RAM by default. rattus128 (C3): CPU/GPU split tested and 'not really effective'; recommends KJNodes FFN-chunker nodes to cut inference VRAM for Wan/LTX on low VRAM.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Know that CPU diffusion is impractically slow, ComfyUI already offloads weights to RAM by default, and KJNodes FFN-chunker is the actual lever for cutting low-VRAM Wan/LTX inference.
